title: 首次AI大选：焦点不是AI，是数据中心，县里还欢迎数据中心吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This year's midterm elections will be the first, where AI will figure prominently.
segments.zh: 今年中期选举将是首次AI议题突出显现的选举。

segments.en: Everyone more or less agrees that the new technology could have great potential, but there is a wide range of concerns about its possible effects.
segments.zh: 大家或多或少都认同新技术潜力巨大，但对其可能影响存在广泛担忧。

segments.en: Everything from what it could mean for employment. The fear surrounding AI, you know, is my son or daughter going to have a job?
segments.zh: 从对就业的影响到对AI的恐惧，比如我孩子将来能有工作吗？

segments.en: I just paid all this tuition, am I going to have a job? To whether it could lead to mass extinction.
segments.zh: 刚交了这么多学费，我能找到工作吗？再到是否可能导致大规模灭绝。

segments.en: AI is just as dangerous as drugs, so we should have an FDA for AI.
segments.zh: AI和药物一样危险，所以我们应该设立AI版的FDA。

segments.en: So public policy needs to support the public good of AI alignment.
segments.zh: 因此公共政策需要支持AI对齐这一公共福祉。

segments.en: But for this particular election, it seems the most pressing concern is over the building of all those data centers needed to support AI.
segments.zh: 但本次选举中最紧迫的担忧似乎是支持AI所需的大量数据中心建设。

segments.en: We do not want any more data centers in our county.
segments.zh: 我们县不再需要任何新的数据中心。

segments.en: This is not a Republican issue. It's not a Democrat issue.
segments.zh: 这不是共和党议题，也不是民主党议题。

segments.en: It's a people issue. You're seeing red states and blue states both look at the data center opportunity and quandary in the same way, which is it can't hurt consumers.
segments.zh: 这是民众议题。红州和蓝州都以同样方式看待数据中心机遇与困境，即不能损害消费者利益。

segments.en: Nobody knows yet what it's going to mean for that community.
segments.zh: 目前没人知道这对该社区意味着什么。

segments.en: They don't know what it's going to mean for their water.
segments.zh: 他们不知道这对他们的水源意味着什么。

segments.en: They don't know what it's going to mean in regard to noise pollution or other types of pollutants.
segments.zh: 他们不知道在噪音污染或其他污染物方面会有什么影响。

segments.en: Resistance to building more data centers has led some states to slow down AI's development.
segments.zh: 对新建更多数据中心的抵制已导致一些州放缓AI发展。

segments.en: We need an immediate pause on advanced AI development and a permanent ban on super intelligence.
segments.zh: 我们需要立即暂停高级AI开发，并永久禁止超级智能。
